package.name: de4sdv_aebs_010_bridge
package.description: DE4SDV INC-AEBS-010 read-only AEBS visualization source bridge. Subscribes to the pinned native Autoware AEB outputs and the DE4SDV 009B coordinator state, assembles versioned visualization frames with per-field provenance, and serves them on a new bounded length-delimited transport. Publishes no ROS topics and exposes no command path.
